record.label: The collective Johnson-graph walk in Find-All
record.statement: The collective walk starts in a uniform superposition over $m$-element subsets and alternates queries that give the parity of the remaining hits with reflections on Johnson eigenspaces that are independent of $S$.
record.boundary: The cited definitions and lemmas specify ideal unitaries in the query model. Some Find-All circuits increase the subset size during the walk, and the choice of circuit depends on $(m,k)$. Separate results would be needed to bound every pass by fewer than $\sqrt{N/m}$ rounds and to give an elementary-gate count and approximation error for a QSVT implementation.
